name: Lazy K
summary: Ben Rudiak-Gould's pure, lazily evaluated SKI-combinator language (2002) where I/O is a lazy stream of Church numerals; accepts combinator, Unlambda, Iota and Jot syntaxes.

level_notes.0: No verified implementation repository linked; implementations are listed on the esolangs.org page.
level_notes.1: No separate author specification could be verified; the encyclopedia/wiki entry describes the language.
